text:
Brian (AE): MedSys POC is stuck. Their ingestion pipeline fails validation on our fn_call output intermittently. Theyre asking for a short mitigation and KMS/network details for Dedicated.

Maya (SE): Can you share the exact failing payload and headers?

Brian (AE): They sent a redacted proxy extract: 

```
2026-04-02T11:12:03Z upstream 422 validation_error
x-req=med-221 id=med-req-21 body=\"{\\\"fn_call\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"name\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"ingestReport\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"arguments\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"patient_id\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"p-77\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"}\\\\\\\"}\\\"}\"
```

Leah (ML Eng): Looks like double-encoded arguments again: fn_call.arguments is a string containing JSON, not an object. Their validator expects an object. Pattern matches previous cases with streaming + json_mode + function_call=auto.

Omar (Infra): We should ask for X-Request-ID header to correlate. I can enable a tenant-scoped sanitizer rule for medsys-221 to unescape top-level quoted JSON in fn_call.arguments while we debug. That requires a short config change and an audit note.

Maya (SE): Immediate mitigation options to propose to MedSys (in order):
- Call with function_call: \"explicit\" and set json_mode: \"relaxed\" temporarily.
- We enable sanitizer that unescapes quoted fn_call.arguments on the tenant route.
- If they require stricter guarantees, propose Dedicated with per-tenant KMS and static IPs (longer lead).

Brian (AE): CISO asked: what KMS integrations do we support and is customer data ever in logs? Need a one-paragraph security answer.

Maya (SE): Short answer: we support cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), and HSM-backed keys for Dedicated. Customer data in transit is not logged in plaintext by default; we redact request bodies in the control plane logs unless customer opts into advanced debug and provides consent. I'll DM the CISO the one-pager and the Dedicated pricing pointer.

Leah (ML Eng): Root cause hypothesis: when streaming flushes partial tool output and the function_call serializer is in auto mode, some outputs are serialized as JSON strings to avoid early parse errors. If the clients proxy then re-wraps or doesn't unescape, the validator fails. I filed INF-7702 to guard against emitting quoted arguments when json_mode is true.

Omar (Infra): Rolling sanitizer for medsys-221 now (stage -> canary -> full) and adding audit note. ops-bot: creating trace...

ops-bot: Trace created https://traces.internal/med-req-21 for correlation. Rule rollout: canary live for medsys-221 (rule id=can-781).

Brian (AE): I asked MedSys to add X-Request-ID: med-req-21 and to retest with function_call explicit at 1pm ET. They confirmed.

Maya (SE): If they still fail, request the raw bytes of the failing response (headers+body) and their schema validator error string. That usually reveals whether the outer layer re-quoted the payload.

Leah (ML Eng): If sanitizer fixes it, we'll ship a targeted runtime patch that avoids string-encoding when json_mode + function_call are both set. Prioritize INF-7702.

Omar (Infra): I'll prepare a small patch to the tenant rule config to limit scope and add rollback. Notify legal for payload mutation sign-off.

Brian (AE): Thanks team. I'll update MedSys and post the retest result here.
